items.item:
10. After anonymising a project it has no revision: correcting or erasing it
    stating its former revision is refused as stale and changes nothing; a
    project deleted whole is not found.
   Shows A04-4, A04-5. [witness: verification:registry_a04_anonymised_project_former_revision_stale]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
  accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
```

statements:

verdicts.why: The check proves accepted anonymisation leaves the exact revision-free project form, then detects stale refusals for correction and both erasure modes using the former revision and verifies that neither persisted state nor the readable card changes. It also deletes another project whole and verifies that both correction and reading return the expected not-found refusal.
